header.title: THE HITMAN RAGDOLL, 2000
header.credit:
Thomas Jakobsen · IO Interactive · Advanced Character Physics, GDC 2001
A Hitman ragdoll, cloth and plants; each stick shows its live constraint error.

a1.heading: A1 · VERLET — NO VELOCITY VARIABLE
a1.alarm: 1.99 IS A VELOCITY DAMP, NOT A POSITION ONE
a1.note: AS PRINTED, A PARTICLE AT REST AT x = 500 DRIFTS 5 u/STEP TOWARD THE ORIGIN.

a2.heading: A2 · THE STICK CONSTRAINT, AND A SIGN
a2.printed: AS PRINTED : x1 = (−10,0)  x2 = (130,0)  → d = 140  DIVERGES
a2.carried: FOUR OF THE FIVE STICK LISTINGS CARRY IT: (C2), STICK-IN-A-BOX, CLOTH, MASS-WEIGHTED.
a2.fifth: THE FIFTH — THE SQRT APPROXIMATION, THE ONE THAT SHIPPED IN HITMAN — IS CORRECT WITH THE SAME TWO ASSIGNMENT LINES, BECAUSE ITS FACTOR IS ALREADY NEGATIVE UNDER TENSION. THE EXPOSITION FORM WAS MADE BY REMOVING THE APPROXIMATION, AND THE SIGN WENT WITH IT.
a2.verdict: THE PAPER'S OWN STICK CODE PUSHES WHEN IT SHOULD PULL.

a3.heading: A3 · THE SQUARE-ROOT APPROXIMATION
a3.note: AGREES IN VALUE AND SLOPE AT u = 1. DENOMINATOR d²+r² ≥ r² > 0, SO IT CANNOT DIVIDE BY ZERO: §7's SINGULARITY NOTE APPLIES ONLY TO THE EXACT FORM.
a3.soft: §7 SOFT CONSTRAINTS: HALF THE DEVIATION PER FRAME.

b1.heading: B1 · FIGURE 9: THE ANATOMY
b1.note: RE-COUNTED AT 600 dpi: THRESHOLD, ERODE BY A DISC r = 8 px — EVERY STICK AND EVERY BODY-TEXT STEM DIES AND EXACTLY 16 COMPONENTS OF 620–657 px SURVIVE. THE PAPER PUBLISHES NO COUNT.

b2.heading: B2 · RELAXATION: 1 · 4 · 10
b2.note: "ITERATIONS USED IN HITMAN VARY BETWEEN 1 AND 10 WITH THE KIND OF OBJECT SIMULATED." — §7. ORDER MATTERS AS MUCH AS COUNT: LISTED FROM THE PIN A CHAIN CONVERGES IN ONE SWEEP AND ALL THREE ARE IDENTICAL. THESE ARE LISTED FROM THE FREE END.

b3.heading: B3 · REST LENGTHS & PRODUCTION
b3.note: restlength = 100 ON THE THIGH FIXES THE FIGURE AT 486.2 UNITS — 48.6% OF THE PAPER'S OWN CUBE. THIGH 100.0 / SHANK 98.0 IS 1.91% APART, SO THE DRILLIS & CONTINI CROSS-CHECK IS DROPPED: NO PRIMARY SCAN, AND THE DIAGRAM WOULD HAVE FAILED IT.
production: IO INTERACTIVE / EIDOS · 19 NOV 2000 · GLACIER · DirectX 7.0a · GDC 2001, SAN JOSE
HITMAN.INI: "enableconsole 1" + "consolecmd ip_debug 1" — SHIFT+F9 BOMBS AN NPC, K = FREE CAM
